verdict.rationale: Penpot's homepage says it can design responsive, rules-based interfaces with CSS Grid and Flex layouts. That covers the auto-layout and grid parts of the story directly, but the only evidence is one marketing line. Missing for 10: any evidence of constraints (pinning/scaling children when a frame resizes), in-depth user-guide documentation of Flex/Grid layout behavior, and hands-on or independent corroboration that frames actually resize the way real UIs flex.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex

citations.quote: Design responsive and rules-based interfaces with wireframes, interactive prototypes, and CSS Grid and Flex layouts.
